title: A Finite-order Characterization of Entrywise Positivity Preservers
summary: Fix $I = (0,ρ)$, where $0<ρ\leq\infty$, and let $\mathbb{P}_n(I)$ be the set of positive semidefinite $n\times n$ matrices with entries in $I$. A longstanding problem in matrix theory is to characterize the functions $f: I \to \mathbb{R}$ for which the entrywise calculus $f[A] = [f(a_{ij})]_{i,j = 1}^{n}$ preserves positive semidefiniteness for all $A \in \mathbb{P}_n(I)$.
